$comment: Source classifier rules (docs/PLAN.md 4.5). Bundle IDs checked on 28 Sep 2026 (installed apps and Homebrew casks). A trailing .* matches any bundle ID with that prefix. Host patterns: *.example.com matches subdomains, name.* matches the name under any domain ending (amazon.co.uk), anything else matches the host and its subdomains. bridge_editors are the editors the Context VS Code extension runs in; pointing at them adds the project from the extension.
